import re
from datetime import datetime


def extract(text: str) -> dict:
    if not re.search(r"BSES\s+Rajdhani\s+Power\s+Limited\s*-\s*Electricity\s+Bill", text, re.I):
        raise ValueError("Missing provider header label")

    amount_match = re.search(
        r"Net\s+Amount\s+Payable\s*\(\s*Rs\.\s*\)\s*([0-9][0-9,]*\.?[0-9]*)",
        text,
        re.I,
    )
    if not amount_match:
        raise ValueError("Missing Net Amount Payable label")

    due_match = re.search(
        r"Due\s+Date\s*([0-9]{1,2}\.[0-9]{1,2}\.[0-9]{4})",
        text,
        re.I,
    )
    if not due_match:
        raise ValueError("Missing Due Date label")

    amount = float(amount_match.group(1).replace(",", ""))
    due_date = datetime.strptime(due_match.group(1), "%d.%m.%Y").strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

    return {
        "type": "bill_due",
        "provider": "BSES Rajdhani",
        "amount": amount,
        "currency": "INR",
        "due_date": due_date,
    }
data.notes: Anchors extraction on the bill header plus Net Amount Payable and Due Date labels, handling comma-grouped INR amounts and dd.mm.yyyy dates.
